# Research Slides

Plan, produce, or audit one evidence-grounded academic talk. Lock the talk contract first, keep one message per slide, and inspect the actual render before making visual-QA claims.

## Prerequisites

- Audience, goal, talk type, time and slide budget, language, anonymity constraints, evidence boundaries, output route, and existing deck or project tooling state.
- Exact scientific figures, tables, equations, and other assets that must remain unaltered.

## Method

1. Lock the talk contract and its non-claims.
2. Inspect supplied papers, validated claims, writing and experiment artifacts, existing decks, and project-local slide tooling before drafting.
3. Outline one main message per slide with source basis, time budget, and asset need. Catalog exact scientific assets before visual production.
4. Use only the root/operator-selected project production route and preserve source figures, tables, equations, and logos exactly.
5. Render the actual deck and inspect every slide for claim support, anonymity, asset fidelity, projector-scale readability, placeholders, and timing. Without a render, make no visual-QA claim.
6. Keep speaker notes and spoken claims inside the same evidence boundary.

## Profiles and output

This package is lightweight-only and has no managed capability. Return the talk contract, one-message-per-slide outline, rendered deck or explicit blocker, and whole-deck render audit. The optional `NOTICE.md` member is root-only provenance and is never worker-visible methodology.

## Stop conditions

Stop after one bounded talk has a contract, outline, rendered deck or blocker, and actual-render audit. Do not launch another production or review stage.

## Authority boundary

Do not invent evidence or renders; launch a provider, model, production specialist, child Skill, Worker, Workflow, capability, Procedure, or Dispatch; mutate canonical Research or Quest state; or invoke a handoff automatically. Write only request-authorized output paths.

## Handoff

Suggest `research-figure`, `research-literature`, `research-experiment`, or `research-writing` only as separately selected work. Never invoke any handoff automatically.
